messages:
maria: Heads up — finance flagged an unexpected GPU charge (~$12k) last billing period tied to a nodepool that wasn't getting proper cost tags. digging now. :eyes:
ajay: which nodepool? any region or instance type pattern?
maria: Looks like `np-ephemeral-worker` in us-west-2 and asia-southeast1. mostly p4d- and a100-like billing SKUs coming from autoscaler-created instances.
finance-bot: FYI cost export: https://billing.redwood.internal/reports/2026-02/unallocated-gpu.csv (read-only link)
sarah: oh — I remember we pushed a guinea-patch to the autoscaler last quarter that swapped launch template defaults. possible the template lost the `cost-center` tag when scale-out used the older template revision.
liyah: if autoscaler used a template without IMDS tagging, tags won't surface to CUR. we should check ASG/Managed nodegroup launch templates and any legacy nodepool definitions in cluster-provisioner.
ajay: quick query I ran on the cost export to surface untagged NICs/instances:
```
SELECT resource_id, product_sku, line_item_usage_start_date, linked_account_id
FROM `billing_exports.gcp_lineitems`
WHERE LOWER(cost_center) IN ('', 'none')
  AND product_sku LIKE '%GPU%'
  AND DATE(line_item_usage_start_date) BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
ORDER BY product_sku
LIMIT 200;
```
maria: good query. Results show majority of those resources have `nodepool=np-ephemeral-worker` in the instance name but no `tag:owner` or `tag:product`.
liyah: plan suggestion: 1) retroactive backfill to map instance -> cluster -> app owner using instance name + k8s node labels; 2) enforce tag injection in launch templates (IMDS-based) and 3) add a cost-policy admission webhook to reject untagged nodepool CRs.
sarah: agree. for (1) we can run a backfill job that: query instances with missing tag, SSH/API to query instance metadata for `k8s-node-labels`, join to our asset DB, and write cost tags via cloud APIs. estimate 4-6h work.
ajay: for AWS specifically I can run a one-off script to tag instances based on `ec2.describe_instances()` + parsing `Tags` and `InstanceProfile`. I'll also generate a mapping CSV for finance.
finance-bot: please attach CSV to ticket for chargeback adjustments. tagging backfill accepted as remediation by billing team — they'll re-run allocation.
maria: created ticket INFRA-3421 and added checklist. assigning owners:
- ajay: one-off AWS backfill script (due EOD tomorrow)
- liyah: GCP backfill + BigQuery join (due +2 days)
- sarah: patch nodepool provisioner and rollout new launch template default (canary -> full in 48h)
- maria: run allocation re-run with finance once tags are backfilled
ajay: quick note: need to be careful with instance termination — tag API calls on ephemeral nodes may race. will do in small windows and mark resources as "backfill_in_progress" tag.
sarah: we'll also add a CI check to `infra-as-code` so future template changes must include `cost-center` and `product` tags.
liyah: for telemetry, I'll add a nightly job that flags any GPU spend > $500/day with missing allocation tags (slack alert to #eng-infra).
maria: sounds good. anyone object to finance doing retroactive chargeback to product buckets after backfill?
ajay: no objections. prefer they hold the reallocation until all clouds have backfill completed.
finance-bot: acknowledged. please ping when backfill CSVs uploaded to the ticket.
deploy-bot: INFRA-3421 created and linked to runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/infra-3421-tag-backfill
maria: action items locked. I'll post status updates in this thread after ajay's script runs. thanks all :thumbsup:
